female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

asset-ownership-faster.title: Mentioning specific asset or business ownership predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
asset-ownership-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference owning a home, a store, or other business assets tend to fund faster for both men and women.

family-responsibilities-slower-general.title: Mentioning family responsibilities or supporting family members predicts slower funding regardless of gender.
family-responsibilities-slower-general.body: Pitches that reference household duties or the need to support family members are associated with slower funding speeds for both men and women.

female-aspirational-language-faster.title: Female borrowers who use aspirational language such as 'dreams' for their business fund faster.
female-aspirational-language-faster.body: Pitches from women that reference dreams or striving for a better future in the context of their business are associated with increased funding speed.

repayment-history-faster.title: Mentioning a history of previous loan repayment predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches that explicitly reference the successful repayment of previous loans are associated with increased funding speed for both men and women.

female-gratitude-slower.body: Female borrowers who explicitly thank lenders in their pitch may fund more slowly.

female-geographic-specificity-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention specific local districts or markets may fund more slowly.

female-expansion-goal-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the goal of expanding their business may fund more slowly.

male-machinery-vs-consumables-faster.body: Male borrowers who specify the purchase of machinery rather than consumables may fund faster.

female-external-challenges-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention external challenges like weather or varying income may fund faster.

female-broad-goals-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention broad goals like food security or environmental impact may fund more slowly.

female-personal-specificity-faster.body: Female borrowers who provide specific personal or business details (age, child count) may fund faster.

female-financial-pressures-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention specific financial pressures like rising costs may fund faster.

female-nwtf-template-faster.body: Female borrowers who use a standardized NWTF template may fund faster.

female-professional-skills-faster.body: Female borrowers who emphasize professional skills and certified inputs may fund faster.

female-children-age-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide specific ages for their children may fund more slowly.
female-children-age-specificity-slower.retrospective: Dropped to make room for geographic specificity puzzle

female-previous-loan-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention having a previous loan may fund more slowly.
female-previous-loan-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that past loans from NWTF accelerate funding

female-operational-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who describe the specific operational benefits of loan inputs fund faster.
female-operational-benefit-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for the general repayment history claim.

male-repayment-history-faster.title: Male borrowers who mention a history of previous loan repayment may fund faster.
male-repayment-history-faster.retrospective: Promoted to a gender-general claim after corroboration in female pairs.

female-age-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who include their specific age in their pitch may fund faster.
female-age-specificity-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning age is associated with slower funding

female-children-count-faster.title: Female borrowers who provide a specific count of children may fund faster.
female-children-count-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning number of children is associated with slower funding

female-children-school-faster.title: Female borrowers who specify that their children are attending school may fund faster.
female-children-school-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that children's schooling status is associated with slower funding

female-financial-pressures-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific external financial pressures or constraints may fund more slowly.
female-financial-pressures-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific financial pressures (rising costs) accelerate funding

female-age-specificity-slower.title: Female borrowers who explicitly state their age in the pitch may fund more slowly.
female-age-specificity-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific personal details accelerate funding

female-children-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide specific counts of children and schooling status may fund more slowly.
female-children-details-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific personal details accelerate funding
